links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT responses on self-managed medication abortion safety and process
links.effect: ChatGPT inaccurately described self-managed medication abortion as dangerous and associated with increased complication risk, contradicting evidence, across responses to 65 questions (about 11,000 words).
links.quote: ChatGPT repeatedly provided responses that overstated the risk of complications associated with self-managed medication abortion in ways that directly contradict the expansive body of evidence demonstrating that self-managed medication abortion is both safe and effective.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT's accuracy and tendency to generate misinformation regarding self-managed medication abortion using a prompt-based simulation.
